description: The file is the main server entry point for an Android Cuttlefish frontend in Go. It sets up HTTP and HTTPS servers, handles command-line flags, and initializes operator components such as device pools, endpoints, and proxies.

methods.name: startHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server listening on the specified address and port.

methods.name: startHttpsServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTPS server with TLS certificates on the specified address and port.

methods.name: maybeIntercept
methods.description: Determines if a device file request should be intercepted and served from the signaling server.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Runs a list of starter functions concurrently and waits for their completion, terminating on error.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command line arguments, initializes operator components, sets up HTTP/HTTPS servers, and runs starter functions.
